h5Academy3rdCombatMage.description:
Mages, Archmages and Combat Mages are the level 4 units of the Heroes V Academy (merged into the Tower). They can all attack at range and cast {Fist of Wrath} and {Cleansing} (2 times per battle, 10 mana), and they have {No Range Penalty} (no ranged penalty) and {Magic Strike} (all troops on the line of fire take damage). Archmages also have {Energy Channel} (the friendly hero's spells cost 2 less mana). Combat Mages also have {Eldritch Aura} (adjacent allies are not hurt by the line damage of magic attacks).

The mysterious Combat Mages live in the beautiful Kalef Oasis. To them, a wizard's mission is to keep increasing the destructive power of his magic, so that it strikes the enemy precisely while its side effects are kept to a minimum.

See also {Mage}, {Archmage}.

h5Academy3rdDjinnVizier.description:
Djinn, Djinn Sultans and Djinn Viziers are the level 5 units of the Heroes V Academy (merged into the Tower). They all fly. Djinn have {25% Magic Proof} (-25% magic damage) and {Random Hex} (casts a random dark curse on an enemy, 3 times per battle). Djinn Sultans also have {50% Magic Proof} (-50% magic damage) and {Random Blessing} (randomly casts curses on enemies or blessings on allies, 3 times per battle). Djinn Viziers also have {75% Magic Proof} (-75% magic damage), {Lightning Immunity} (immune to Air magic) and {Luck Gambler} (allies +1–3 Luck or enemies -1–3, 3 times per battle).

Djinn Viziers have the power to foresee the future. The side that has djinn can stay lucky throughout the battle, while its enemies are plagued by misfortune. Djinn Viziers can decide how to bestow luck: they can bring good fortune to their own troops, or make the enemy taste bad luck.

See also {Djinn}, {Djinn Sultan}.

h5Academy3rdGremlinSaboteur.description:
Gremlins, Master Gremlins and Gremlin Saboteurs are the level 1 units of the Heroes V Academy (merged into the Tower). They can all attack at range. Master Gremlins also have {Mend} (repairs mechanical units or war machines, restoring 5 × number of gremlins Hit Points). Gremlin Saboteurs also have {Sabotage} (disables an enemy mechanical unit for 1 round; requires total Hit Points × 10 > the target's).

The Gremlin Saboteur's task is to wreck whatever it can, which makes it an extremely important unit on the battlefield. Golems, catapults or town fortifications: once it has its eye on them, their fate is sealed.

See also {Gremlin}, {Master Gremlin}.

h5Academy3rdMarbleGargoyle.description:
Stone Gargoyles, Obsidian Gargoyles and Marble Gargoyles are the level 2 units of the Heroes V Academy (merged into the Tower). They all fly and have {Elemental} (non-living, immune to Mind magic) and {Enrage} (Attack rises when a friendly stack is destroyed). Stone Gargoyles have {Lightning Immunity} (immune to Air magic). Obsidian Gargoyles also have {Lightning Immunity} (immune to Air magic), {Immune to Fire} (immune to Fire magic) and {Immune to Water} (immune to Water magic). Marble Gargoyles also have {Fire Vulnerability Aura} (it and adjacent stacks take +50% Fire magic damage), {Ice Vulnerability Aura} (it and adjacent stacks take +50% Water magic damage) and {Air Vulnerability Aura} (it and adjacent stacks take +50% Air magic damage).

Long, long ago, ancient books described in detail the Marble Gargoyles made of golden marble. Refined by the Magic Brotherhood, this rare stone can draw on the elemental forces of nature. Everything around a Marble Gargoyle becomes especially vulnerable to fire, ice and lightning, friend and foe alike, and a mage who knows how to work with it can turn fire, ice and lightning into devastating weapons.

See also {Stone Gargoyle}, {Obsidian Gargoyle}.

h5Academy3rdObsidianGolem.description:
Iron Golems, Steel Golems and Magnetic Golems are the level 3 units of the Heroes V Academy (merged into the Tower). They all have {Mechanical} (mechanical creature, immune to Mind magic). Iron Golems have {Immune to Slow} (immune to Slow) and {50% Magic Proof} (-50% magic damage). Steel Golems also have {Unlimited Retaliation}, {Immune to Slow} (immune to Slow) and {75% Magic Proof} (-75% magic damage). Magnetic Golems also have {Enchanted Obsidian} (immune to non-damaging magic; damaging magic restores 50% of its damage as Hit Points) and {Magic Magnetism} (allies caught in area spells take less damage, and half of the reduction goes to healing).

Magnetic Golems never fear mages. Apart from spells that deal damage directly, no magic has any effect on them, and when damaging spells hit them, half is converted into energy that repairs them. They can also draw area spells falling on nearby allies onto themselves, sharing the damage on their allies' behalf.

See also {Iron Golem}, {Steel Golem}.

h5Academy3rdRakshasaKshatri.description:
Rakshasa Ranis, Rakshasa Rajas and Rakshasa Kshatras are the level 6 units of the Heroes V Academy (merged into the Tower). Rakshasa Ranis have {No Enemy Retaliation}. Rakshasa Rajas have {No Enemy Retaliation} and {Dash} (forgoes this action, then doubles its Speed for the next 3 rounds). Rakshasa Kshatras have {Whirlwind} (attacks the enemies directly ahead and diagonally ahead at once) and {Dash} (forgoes this action, then doubles its Speed for the next 3 rounds).

“Spirits of Death”: this is the title people give the Academy's fearsome Rakshasa Kshatras. They are strong, agile, bloodthirsty and well equipped, and they make anyone who dares come near tremble. The Spirits of Death never leave survivors and slay without mercy whoever stands in their way.

See also {Rakshasa Rani}, {Rakshasa Raja}.

h5Academy3rdStormLord.description:
Giants, Titans and Storm Lords are the level 7 units of the Heroes V Academy (merged into Tower). All of them have {Mind Control Immunity} (immune to Mind magic). Titans can also shoot and have {No Melee Penalty} and {Call Lightning} (lightning damage = 30 × the number of Titans, Air, cannot be retaliated against). Storm Lords can also shoot and have {No Melee Penalty} and {Stormcaller} (summons a thundercloud for 3 rounds that deals damage every round and suppresses shooting).

Storm Lords are born with power to rival the gods. A Storm Lord can summon a violent tempest that sweeps across the whole battlefield. Lightning pours endlessly from the heart of the storm, and the gale easily tears the bows from archers' hands; hapless enemies suddenly find themselves victims of the raging elements.

See also {Giant}, {Titan}.

Archmages also have {Energy Channel} (spells cast by the allied hero cost -2 mana). Combat Mages also have {Eldritch Aura} (adjacent allies take no damage when they are in the line of a Magic Strike).

The most powerful Mages can be promoted to Archmages and gain more spells. Once Archmages take the field, the hero commanding them gains more mana.

Djinn, Djinn Sultans and Djinn Viziers are the level 5 units of the Heroes V Academy (merged into Tower). All of them can fly. Djinn have {25% Magic Proof} (-25% magic damage) and {Random Hex} (casts a random Dark curse on an enemy, 3 times per battle). Djinn Viziers also have {75% Magic Proof} (-75% magic damage), {Lightning Immunity} (immune to Air magic) and {Luck Gambler} (Luck +1–3 for an ally or -1–3 for an enemy, 3 times per battle).

Djinn are ancient elemental spirits that Mages can summon and bind to themselves. Once bound, a Djinn can never break free; it serves and protects its master faithfully until its essence is spent. On the battlefield Djinn are a highly effective fighting force, but because of their chaotic and unpredictable nature no one can guess which spell they will use against the enemy. One thing is certain, though: they will never harm their own side. Nor are Djinn limited to casting spells in battle, for their heavy scimitars are deadly as well.

See also {Djinn Sultan}, {Djinn Vizier}.

h5AcademyGiant.description:
Giants, Titans and Storm Lords are the level 7 units of the Heroes V Academy (merged into Tower). All of them have {Mind Control Immunity} (immune to Mind magic). Titans can also shoot and have {No Melee Penalty} and {Call Lightning} (lightning damage = 30 × the number of Titans, Air, cannot be retaliated against). Storm Lords can also shoot and have {No Melee Penalty} and {Stormcaller} (summons a thundercloud for 3 rounds that deals damage every round and suppresses shooting).

Of all the creatures that Mages build or summon, Giants are the mightiest. They are made on the same principle as Gremlins, but on a far greater scale. Each Giant is fused with the soul of its maker, which gives it an unshakable will and ensures its absolute loyalty to the Mage, so Giants are immune to Mind Control magic. Rather than wield weapons, they prefer to swing their huge arms, using all manner of close-combat techniques to deal their enemies crushing blows.

See also {Titan}, {Storm Lord}.

Master Gremlins also have {Mend} (repairs a mechanical unit or war machine, restoring 5 × the number of Gremlins in Hit Points). Gremlin Saboteurs also have {Sabotage} (disables an enemy mechanical unit for 1 round; the stack's total Hit Points × 10 must exceed the target's).

Gremlins are in fact the product of magical experiments on captured garden sprites, though they are cleverer and more docile than garden sprites. They are the most basic unit of a Mage's army and are usually adept at striking the enemy from range with their fire-bomb launchers. Because these launchers are very sturdy, Gremlins also use them as metal clubs in hand-to-hand combat.

See also {Master Gremlin}, {Gremlin Saboteur}.

Golems are mechanical soldiers of ancient magic and were once the main battle units of the Silver Cities. Each wields 2 long scimitars, and its body is its armor. Golems are unaffected by Slow-type spells and are highly resistant to magic (all magic damage is halved).

See also {Steel Golem}, {Magnetic Golem}.

Some of the Mages of the Silver Cities serve in the army. Armed only with a dagger and far from skilled at fighting, they are very weak in close combat. Compared with the powerful magic they command, however, these shortcomings can be all but ignored. Mages carry scrolls that grant them additional spells.

See also {Archmage}, {Combat Mage}.

h5AcademyRakshasa.description:
Rakshasa Ranis, Rakshasa Rajas and Rakshasa Kshatras are the level 6 units of the Heroes V Academy (merged into Tower). Rakshasa Ranis have {No Enemy Retaliation}. Rakshasa Rajas have {No Enemy Retaliation} and {Dash} (gives up the current action to double Speed for the next 3 rounds). Rakshasa Kshatras have {Whirlwind} (attacks the enemies directly ahead and diagonally ahead at the same time) and {Dash} (gives up the current action to double Speed for the next 3 rounds).

Rakshasa Ranis are vengeful spirits from a forgotten age that have wandered the fringes of Ashan for thousands of years. Some wandering mages and warlocks rediscovered these creatures, consumed by their thirst for revenge, and after many trials and failures finally mastered the means of summoning and controlling them. Rakshasa Ranis are an impressive force on the battlefield, and their lion-headed, many-armed bodies often send a chill through their foes. So intimidating are their attacks that enemies cannot retaliate against them.

See also {Rakshasa Raja}, {Rakshasa Kshatra}.

Rakshasa Kshatras have {Whirlwind} (attacks the enemies directly ahead and diagonally ahead at the same time) and {Dash} (gives up the current action to double Speed for the next 3 rounds).

Rakshasa Rajas are as formidable as Rakshasa Ranis, but in an emergency they can also put on a sudden burst of speed and move swiftly.

See also {Rakshasa Rani}, {Rakshasa Kshatra}.

See also {Iron Golem}, {Magnetic Golem}.

Stone Gargoyles are statues of flying creatures brought to life by magic. Because they can fly and often crush their enemies with heavy stone slabs, even Mages must treat them with caution. Stone Gargoyles are immune to Lightning magic.

See also {Obsidian Gargoyle}, {Marble Gargoyle}.

Titans are the highest achievement a Mage can dream of. Like Giants, Titans like to swing their huge hands in melee to crush their foes. They are immune to Mind Control magic and can unleash lightning to strike distant enemies.

See also {Giant}, {Storm Lord}.
